description: A script for managing Daily.co recordings: fetching recordings older than 6 months, saving to JSON, and deleting them with user confirmation.

methods.name: getAllRecordingsOlderThan6Months
methods.description: Fetches all recordings older than 6 months from the Daily.co API, handling pagination and rate limiting.

methods.name: saveRecordingsToJson
methods.description: Saves a list of recordings to a JSON file with simplified data.

methods.name: deleteRecording
methods.description: Deletes a specific recording by ID from the Daily.co API, with retries on failure.

methods.name: deleteRecordingsFromJson
methods.description: Deletes recordings listed in a JSON file, with optional dry run mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to fetch, process, and display recordings older than 6 months.

methods.name: mainDelete
methods.description: Interactive function to confirm and execute deletion of recordings listed in JSON.
